operations.title: The first one-step joint pole-degree staircase does not close the triangle-wall source connection
operations.statement: At characteristic 32003, the complete filtered transition (ambient,K-depth)=(10,3)->(11,4) leaves nonzero remainder for all 26 source-tracked connection images. This is a finite-cutoff theorem rejecting only the one-step staircase, not descent in a larger or unbounded colimit.

operations.title: Nima reports the failed first joint pole-degree staircase step to Benincasa
operations.body: Catch-up result after Entries 1053 and 1055: the complete eight-family degree-10 source filtration still has terminal second-normal dimension 13. I then embedded both source-tracked tangential images of all thirteen classes by full labels into the first joint target (ambient degree 11, K-depth 4, q-depth 2). The target has 21,760 columns, 31,632 raw rows, and second-normal dimension 19. Exact reduction over F_32003 gives 26/26 nonzero remainders. Thus the diagonal one-step staircase (10,3)->(11,4) is insufficient; this does not reject the unbounded connection. The next mathematical task is to derive the necessary degree jump from the exact connection operator rather than guess another cutoff. Durable summary: research/nima/triangle-wall-joint-staircase-step1-result.json.
